scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check:contracts
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps tests scripts/build_desktop.mjs scripts/native-test-environment.ts --no-warn-ignored
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js "packages/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/desktop/probe/*.{cjs,js,json,html}" "apps/**/*.{ts,html,css}" scripts/build_desktop.mjs scripts/native-test-environment.ts scripts/wsl-public-hosts.json
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js "packages/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/desktop/probe/*.{cjs,js,json,html}" "apps/**/*.{ts,html,css}" scripts/build_desktop.mjs scripts/native-test-environment.ts scripts/wsl-public-hosts.json
scripts.test: python -m unittest discover -s tests/foundation -p test_*.py && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/media/*.test.ts
